জানিনা জানিনা জানিনা সংগ্রামী উপস্থিতি আমরা আমাদের নেতৃবৃন্দদেরকে হারিয়েছি আমরা আমাদের শহীদ নেতৃবৃন্দদের রক্তের প্রতিশোধ নিতে চাই সেই রক্তের প্রতিশোধ নিব বাংলাদেশের প্রত্যেকটি ঘরে ইসলামের আহ্বান ইসলামী দিনাজপুর জেলা শাখা কর্তৃক আয়োজিত আজকের এই কর্মী সম্মেলনের সম্মানিত প্রধান অতিথি সম্মানিত সভাপতি সংগ্রামী জনতা আমরা গত 15 বছর ইসলামী ছাত্রশিবিরের পর অসংখ্য নির্যাতন দেখেছি এই আওয়ামী আমলে ছাত্রশিবিরের প্রায় 150 জনকে শহীদ করা হয়েছে আমরা বলে দিতে চাই ভাই তোমরা যতই শহীদ করো না কেন যতই জুলুম নির্যাতন করো না কেন কখনোই ছাত্রশিবিরের এই পথচলাকে তোমরা থামাতে পারবে না ইনশাআল্লাহ ছাত্রশিবির প্রত্যেকটি ছাত্রের মাঝে ইসলামের সুমহান আদর্শের কথা পৌঁছে দিবে ইনশাআল্লাহ সম্মানিত [মিউজিক] উপস্থিতি আমরা যারা এখানে আজকে আসছি আমরা যদি আমরা আজকে কিছু কাজ নিয়ে যেতে চাই এই আওয়ামী সরকার ইসলামকে বাংলাদেশ থেকে নিশ্চিহ্ন করতে চেয়েছে আমরা প্রত্যেকটি ঘরে ঘরে কোরআনের দাওয়াত পৌঁছে দিতে পারবো ইনশাআল্লাহ সম্মানিত উপস্থিতি তারা আমাদের অসংখ্য নেতাকর্মীকে শহীদ করেছে এর বদলা হিসেবে আমরা বাংলাদেশকে একটি কোরআনের আইন দিয়ে একটি সুখী রাষ্ট্র পরিচালনা করতে চাই সম্মানিত ভাইয়েরা আমাদের প্রত্যেকটি ঘরে ঘরে ইসলামের আহ্বান পৌঁছে দিতে হবে তার সর্বপ্রথম একটি কাজ আমাদেরকে প্রথমে নিজেদেরকে ভালো হতে হবে এবং নিজেদেরকে সৎ চরিত্রবান হতে হবে তারপর প্রত্যেকটি ঘরে ঘরে কোরআনের দাওয়াত পৌঁছে দিয়ে আগামীর দেশকে আমরা একটি কোরআনের আলোয় আলোকিত দেশ করতে চাই ইনশাআল্লাহ এই আহ্বান জানিয়ে আমি আমার কথা এখানে শেষ করছি আসসালামু আলাইকুম ওয়ারাহমাতুল্লাহি ওয়াবারাকাতুহু ধন্যবাদ ছাত্রনেতা রাসেল রানাকে তার গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কথা কথা বলার জন্য এ পর্যায়ে ছোট্ট করে সালাম বিনিময় করছেন বিরল বোতাগঞ্জ উপজেলার গণমানুষের অভিভাবক বিরল উপজেলার সাবেক ভাইস চেয়ারম্যান জনাব অধ্যক্ষ এ কেএম আফজালুল আনাম আলহামদুলিল্লাহি রাব্বিল আলামিন আসসালাতু আসসালামু আলা সাইয়েদিল মুরসালিন ওয়ালা আলিহি ওয়া আসহাবিহি আজমাইন আজকে দিনাজপুর জেলার এই বৃহৎ মাঠে বাংলাদেশ জামাতে ইসলামীর কর্মী সম্মেলনের সম্মানিত আমাদের রাহবার যিনি আমাদেরকে পথ দেখাচ্ছেন অন্তত এই বাংলাদেশের অবস্থাকে সামনে রেখে যিনি আজকে তার বক্তৃতা শোনার জন্য অধীর জনাব ডাক্তার শফিকুর বিনিময়ে আসলে আমরা জেনি রাহবার তার কথা শুনবো আপনারা আজকে যারা এসছেন সত্যিকার অর্থে যেন আমরা শেষ পর্যন্ত আল্লাহর উপর ভরসা করে শেষ পর্যন্ত সম্মেলনটাকে সফল করার জন্য সার্বিক সহযোগিতা কামনা করছি আর সকলে করে দিতে চেয়েছিল সংগ্রামী ভাইয়েরা আমার আজকের এই দিনাজপুরবাসীকে স্পষ্ট করে বলছি বাংলাদেশ জামাত ইসলামী ব্যতীত আর কোন রাজনৈতিক সংগঠনের প্রথম সারি 10 জন নেতাকে যদি হত্যা করা হতো শহীদ করা হতো অসংখ্য এই উত্তরবঙ্গের নেতা জনাব এটিএমএর ইসলামকে বন্দি করে রাখা হয়েছে দিতে হবে সংগ্রামী ভাইয়েরা আমার পরিশেষে আবারো বলছি আসুন আগামী দিনে জন্য আমাদের যে স্বপ্ন নিয়ে আমরা কাজ শুরু করেছিলাম সেই স্বপ্ন বাস্তবায়নে এই প্রিয় কাফেলার সর্বস্তরের জনশক্তিকে কাজ করতে হবে সংগ্রামী ভাইয়েরা আমার আমাদেরকে হত্যা করে আন্দোলনকে বন্ধ করা যাবে না জেলে পুড়ে আমাদের আন্দোলনকে বন্ধ করা যাবে না ইনশাআল্লাহ তাই আগামী দিনে দুর্নীতিমুক্ত বাংলাদেশের জন্য জীবন দিয়েছিলেন তাই আসুন আমরা এই দিনাজপুরকে ইসলামের ঘাটিতে পরিণত করি আল্লাহর আইন এবং সৎ লোকের শাসন প্রতিষ্ঠায় এর চলে মাটির মানুষরা অতীতে ভূমিকা রেখেছে আগামী দিনেও ভূমিকা রাখবে ইনশাআল্লাহ সবাইকে আন্তরিক ধন্যবাদ জানিয়ে আমার কথা শেষ করছি আসসালামু আলাইকুম ওয়ারাহমাতুল্লাহ ধন্যবাদ সাবেক কেন্দ্রীয় সভাপতি জনাব দেলোয়ার হোসেন ভাইকে সম্মানিত কর্মী ভাই ও বোনেরা এ পর্যায়ে মাহবুবুর রহমান বেলাল আউজুবিল্লাহি মিনাশ শাইতানির রাজিম বিসমিল্লাহির রহমানির রাহিম নাহমাদুহুসাল্লি আলা রাসুল কারীম বাংলাদেশের সবচেয়ে মজলুম সংগঠন বাংলাদেশ জামাত ইসলামী দিনাজপুর জেলা শাখা কর্তৃক আয়োজিত আজকের এই বিশাল কর্মী সম্মেলনের সম্মানিত সভাপতি সভাপতি দিনাজপুরের জননেতা সংগ্রামী জননেতা অধ্যক্ষ আনিসুর রহমান আমাদের মাঝে উপস্থিত রয়েছেন আগামী দিনে নতুন মানবিক বাংলাদেশ গড়ার বলিষ্ঠ কণ্ঠস্বর বাংলাদেশের মানুষের কণ্ঠস্বর আমাদের আমিরে জামাত জননন্দিত নেতা জনাব ডাক্তার শফিকুর রহমান উপস্থিত কেন্দ্রীয় আঞ্চলিক জেলা উপজেলার সম্মানিত নেতৃবৃন্দ এবং প্রাণপ্রিয় কর্মী ভাই ও বোনেরা আসসালামু আলাইকুম ওয়ারাহমাতুল্লাহি ওয়াবারাকাতুহু 5ই আগস্টের পরে আপনারা কেমন আছেন আলহামদুলিল্লাহ আল্লাহর রহমত আর আমাদের মুক্তি পাগল ছাত্রজনতার হাজারো কোরবানি রক্তের বিনিময়ে আমরা এই মূল্যবান মুক্তি পেয়েছি নাজাত পেয়েছি জালেমের হাত থেকে ভাইয়েরা আমার আপনারা সবাই সাক্ষী 16 বছর আমাদের এই প্রিয় মাতৃভূমি একটি খুনি ডাকাত দলের হাতে বন্দি ছিল সেই দলের নেত্রীর নাম হলো খুনি শেখ হাসিনা সেই খুনি শেখ হাসিনা যিনি এই দেশটাকে পুরো জেলখানা বানিয়েছিলেন কসাইখানা বানিয়েছিলেন হাজার হাজার ছাত্রকে হত্যা করেছেন ক্রসফায়ার করেছেন ঘুম করেছেন খুন করেছেন আয়না ঘর বানিয়েছেন 26 লক্ষ কোটি টাকা দুর্নীতির মধ্যে পাচার করেছেন সেই শেখ হাসিনা এখন কোথায় দিল্লিতে ভারতে আমাদের প্রশ্ন ভারত যদি আমাদের সৎ প্রতিবেশী হয় বন্ধু হয় তাহলে কিভাবে একজন গণহত্যাকারী খুনি লুটেরাকে তারা আশ্রয় দিতে পারে ভারত মূলত বাংলাদেশের কল্যাণ চায় না ভারত প্রমাণ করে এই খুনি শেখ হাসিনাকে দীর্ঘ 16 বছর [প্রশংসা] অবৈধভাবে হিসেবে তাদের স্বার্থ রক্ষা করবে আর বাংলাদেশ তাকে ধ্বংস করে ছাড়বে এজন্যই শেখ হাসিনাকে তারা আশ্রয় দিয়েছে আমরা দাবি করছি অবিলম্বে শেখ হাসিনাকে বাংলাদেশের মানুষের কাছে ফিরিয়ে দিতে হবে যেন তিনি তার খুনের বিচার ন্যাজ্য বিচার পান ঠিক কিনা বলেন আপনারা সবাই বিচার চান হাততালেন আমরা ভারতীয় আধিপত্যবাদী শক্তিকে বলছি আপনাদের কর্মকাণ্ডের মাধ্যমে প্রমাণ করছেন যে আপনারা আমাদের সৎ প্রতিবেশী নন এই শেখ হাসিনা শুধু আশ্রয়তা দেয় নাই তারা বাংলাদেশ বিরোধী ভিত্তিহীন প্রচারণা উস্কানিমূলক প্রচারণা চালিয়ে যাচ্ছে শুধু তাই নয় আমরা যে দূতাবাস আন্তর্জাতিকভাবে যে নিরাপত্তা দিতে বাধ্য ভারত তার নিরাপত্তা না দিয়ে আমাদের দুই দুটি উপদূতাবাসে ভারতীয় উগ্র জনগোষ্ঠী সরকারের ইন্ধনে হামলা চালিয়েছে অবিলম্বে তাদের বিচার করতে হবে এই ভারত বাংলাদেশের সৃষ্টির পর থেকেই প্রমাণ করেছে তারা আধিপত্যবাদী শক্তি তারা আমাদের কল্যাণ চায় না হাজার হাজার মানুষ মানুষকে বাংলাদেশীকে তারা অন্যায়ভাবে সীমান্তে গুলি করে লাশ ঝুলিয়ে রেখেছে তার প্রমাণ হলো ফেরানি সীমান্ত হত্যা তারপর তারা আমাদের অভিন্ন করে কেমনে করে বন্যার সময় বাঁধ খুলে দিয়ে আমাদের এই দেশকে ভাসিয়ে দেয় ফসল জনগণ জানমাল সব ধ্বংস হয়ে যায় তারা শুকনা মৌসুমে বাঁধ আটকিয়ে দিয়ে আমাদের ন্যাজ্য পানি দেখে বঞ্চিত করে এবং সেই পানির অভাবে বাংলাদেশের মানুষ সঠিকভাবে আবাদ করতে পারে না ঠিক কিনা বলেন এটা বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ সম্পর্কের প্রমাণ হতে পারে না তারা তাদের পচা মাল অচল মাল বাংলাদেশের নির্বিবাদে পাঠিয়ে দেয় রপ্তানি করে আমাদের পণ্য তারা নিতে চায় না এজন্য কোটি কোটি টাকার বাণিজ্য ঘাটতি সবসময় লেগেই আছে এই হাসিনাকে নিয়ে খুনিয়াকে নিয়ে আবারো ষড়যন্ত্র করছে হাসিনাকে রক্ষা করে আবারো তারা ভারতীয় দালালকে বাংলাদেশে পাঠিয়ে আবারো তাদের দখল দায়িত্ব কায়েম করতে চায় আমরা এই দখল হতে দেবো না বাংলার মানুষ ভারতীয় আধিপত্যবাদী শক্তি এবং দাঁতের দোসর থেকে বাংলাদেশকে মুক্ত করেছে আগামী দিনে মুক্ত রাখবে title: KJBU Classroom: Blessing Of Spiritual Fruit {Galatians 5:18-6:10}
description:
#Blessing #SpiritualFruit #Galatians

Galatians 5:18-6:10 is a powerful passage that offers practical advice for believers. In this letter section, Paul encourages the Galatians to live by the Spirit and walk in love and humility.

Galatians 5:18, Paul explains that when we live by the Spirit, we are no longer under the law and free to follow God's will. He then contrasts the works of the flesh, which include sexual immorality, idolatry, and jealousy, with the fruit of the Spirit, which includes love, joy, peace, patience, and kindness. 

Galatians 6:1-5, Paul emphasizes the importance of bearing one another's burdens and supporting Christ's followers. He encourages us to approach others with gentleness and humility, restoring them gently when they fall into sin. Paul reminds us that we are all part of the same body of Christ and should be quick to offer help and support to those in need.

Galatians 6:6-10, Paul explains the importance of sowing to the Spirit and not growing weary in doing good. He reminds us that we will reap what we sow and that if we invest our time, energy, and resources into building up God's kingdom, we will harvest blessings in due time. Paul encourages us to do good to everyone, especially our fellow believers, and to never give up in our pursuit of godliness.

Overall, Galatians 5:18-6:10 is a powerful reminder that we, followers of Christ, are called to live by the Spirit and walk in love and humility. This passage offers practical advice for how to do so, encouraging us to bear one another's burdens, sow to the Spirit, and never grow weary in doing good.

title: Part 1 - Healthy Living for Life - Learn About Hip and Knee Replacements
description:
Pain and limited movement are the biggest reasons for a hip or knee replacement. But at what point should a person have surgery? In this episode we’ll get the answer to that question and along the way learn all about hip and knee replacements.

Healthy Living for Life is a weekly series sponsored, produced and hosted by Mountain-Pacific Quality Health.

Healthy Living for Life offers a line-up of guests who will cover some tough topics like taking the keys from an aging parent, caregiver burnout and making end-of-life decisions. We’ll also have experts who can offer tips for staying safe in the hospital and getting the most out of visits with your doctor.

title: Interview mit U17 Aufstiegstrainer Achim Imrich
description:
Tolle Neuigkeiten unserer U17! Das Team von Achim Imrich ist frühzeitig in die Junioren Bundesliga aufgestiegen. Wie sich der Aufstieg angefühlt hat und wie er auf die Saison zurückblickt, erfahrt Ihr im Video. 
Das letzte Heimspiel der U17 findet am Samstag, 20. Mai 2017, um 14 Uhr auf dem Kunstrasenplatz oberhalb der Voith-Arena statt! 
Website: http://www.fc-heidenheim.de/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FCH1846/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fch_1846/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/FCH1846
transcript: Congratulations on the promotion, Achim , with the U17 team, now in the Bundesliga next season. Have you celebrated yet? Yes, thank you very much. We haven't celebrated yet because it was an early game and we had a day off. I think everyone celebrated a little bit for themselves, but of course we'll catch up as a team later. And then to be able to celebrate this promotion, this promotion to the Bundesliga properly. How did it feel to secure the promotion with three games to go? Well, I think we started the season with high expectations. Internally, we had the clear goal of being among the top players until the end, with the team. To simply achieve promotion to the Bundesliga. And that happened with three games to go. It's incredible for us and for the club, of course, the next step in the development of our Hartmann youth academy. To simply continue to be successful. And what's your conclusion? What do you take away from the season? Okay, my conclusion is, first of all, huge compliments to the entire team, to the entire coaching team, and to the support from within the club. Right from the start of the season, we tried to keep the boys in a good mood with a certain seriousness, discipline and a lot of fun, to give them a good feeling that they could simply perform at their best. Despite dropping points in the first half of the season, we managed to do very well there. On top of that, we have already managed to send two players from the U17 team to the winter training camp with the professionals. We have now also managed to play 10 to 12 games in the U19 team. And looking back, that is of course a great success for us. Yes, and then on May 20th, there will probably be a big celebration here, hopefully after the last home game. Yes, exactly. As I said, since this will be the last handball of the season and many of the boys will have to leave the club, we naturally want to make the home game a positive one. Of course, we would also be very happy to have the greatest support. On the one hand, of course, from everyone, perhaps the parents of the boys, and of course also from the fans of the club, who perhaps want to see another good football game in the Bundesliga, and also support and cheer on the Bundesliga team. And as I said, we also want to end the season with the home team and win the last home game. Okay, then we definitely hope that on May 20th, the U17s can celebrate properly in the locker room.

description:
Kummi is a folk dance, popular in Tamil Nadu and Kerala in India, danced mostly by Tamil women in circle. Dancing may be different. In some places, it is very simple, with rhythmic clapping. In other places dancers imitate various harvesting activities. Kummi often accompany by songs, called "Kummi songs". It is often danced during festivals. Kummi songs became a popular addition to kuthiyottam festivities in modern times.

Kummi is one of the most important and ancient forms of village dances of Tamil Nadu. It originated when there were no musical instruments, with the participants clapping their hands to keep time. This is performed by women; many varieties of Kummi, such as, Poonthatti Kummi, Deepa Kummi, Kulavai Kummi, Kadir Kummi, Mulaipari Kummi, etc. are known.

The origin of Kummi dance is dated back to the prehistoric times when no traces of any musical instrument were found. The word ‘Kummi’ has derived from Telugu word ‘Kommai’ which literally means dancing with clapping of hands to time and singing poems. Since the dance has originated without accompaniment of any musical beats, the dancers clap their hands to keep time. Kummi is one of the most primeval folk dance forms practiced by the native villagers of Tamil Nadu. These native dwellers are essentially agriculture centric and thrive on occupations like farming, harvest etc. which is reflected in their dance performances.
Kummi is usually performed by a group of Tamil women in a circle. This folk dance however assumes different forms. In some places, it is very simple, with rhythmic clapping while in other places the group of dancers imitates various harvesting activities.

In the simple Kummi dance, the women stand in a circle and dance clapping their hands rhythmically. The dance steps are also repetitive; they hold hands, move forward, bend down and clap their hands. One of the women leads the singing with a favorites song while the rest take up the dance. Each performer sings a new line in turn and the dance stops when all get tired. Facial expressions play an important role in Kummi dance.

In some local variation of the Kummi dance, men are also seen participating along with the women. In this type of dance, the men form a circle with sticks in their hands, inside which the women stand in a smaller ring. The main thing to be enjoyed in this dance form is the synchronization between clapping of the hands by the women and the beating of the sticks by men.

►Synopsis:
As the first-born daughter of an official, Luo Yi Ning even though has been misguided and mistreated by her father’s favorite concubine, decides to come back to her home to investigate and avenge her mother's death. With the help from Luo Shen Yuan, Yi Ning’s half sibling and also her brother, Yi Ning successfully navigates the family drama and catches the murderer. title: Dr Alfredo Ulloa-Aguirre – Chaperoning essential proteins: The quality control system of the cell...
description:
Dr Alfredo Ulloa-Aguirre, National Autonomous University of Mexico

In eukariotes, proteins are synthesized in a cellular organelle called endoplasmic reticulum, where they fold to reach a 3-dimensional configuration. If protein folding fails as a result of a mutation in its corresponding sequence, the misfolded conformer is degraded and thereby unable to express and act at its site of action in the cell. Molecular chaperones are essential components of the complex quality control system (QCS) of the cell; QCS monitors that newly synthesized proteins are folded properly before continuing their intracellular trafficking to their final destination. In the case of cell surface membrane proteins (such as membrane receptors and ion channels) that act as mediators of extracellular signals, their absence due to misrouting leads to an array of diseases. A new strategy to overcome the misfolding problem is by the so-called pharmacological chaperones or pharmacoperones, which are small, synthetic molecules that act as molecular frameworks to assist misfolded proteins to fold properly and adopt a more stable, minimal free-energy conformation to pass the scrutiny of the cell’s QCS, thereby correcting misrouting. In this presentation, I will briefly describe the molecular basis of pharmacoperone action as a potential therapeutic strategy to cure an array of human diseases caused by misrouting of membrane receptors, using as examples the gonadotropin-releasing hormone receptor and the gonadotropin receptors, which are essential for reproductive function.

title: Тринадцатое созвездие - Теплица
description:
"13 Созвездие - Теплица" - мой любимый стих
 не найдя здесь - решил добавить 

извиняюсь за отсутствие динамики в видео (фото Константин Михайлов)

На газ не жмёшь, чтоб не разбиться.
 Тебе на уши "давит" рок...
 Построй вокруг себя теплицу,
 А то поднялся ветерок.

А я люблю под сильным ветром
 На паруса сменить весло,
 Чтоб не считая километров
 Быстрей течение несло.

Люблю я бешеные ритмы,
 Толпу взлохмаченных голов,
 Люблю, когда крутые рифмы,
 Когда не подбирают слов...

Люблю на газ жать до отказа...
 Пусть не хватают тормоза,
 Пускай виляет моя трасса
 И станет уже полоса!!!

А ты построй себе теплицу
 И дозревай в ней, как лимон.
 Уж если спать, так спать с царицей,
 А воровать, так миллион.

Считаю не бывает бури,
 что не приносит перемен
И лучше умереть от пули,
Чем старой смерти сдаться в плен.


Я ненавижу спать в пол тела,
 А если пить, так пить до дна...
 Пусть птица счастья улетела...
 Не верю, что она одна!

А тот, кто выстроил теплицу
 От стенки к стенке ходит в ней...
 Он так хотел огородиться:
 А вдруг поднимется метель,

Седой зимы промчатся сани,
 Замёрзнет в озере вода?!
 Но если спички есть в кармане,
 С огнём не страшны холода.

Природа многое решает,
 Но надо жить снегам назло!
 Люблю огонь - он разрушает,
 Но дарит свет, несёт тепло.

В огне невиданная сила -
 Он чистоту в полях творит.
 Так пусть горит всё то, что сгнило,
 Всё то, что высохло горит.

Не ждите даром караваны
 Те, что давно ушли на дно,
 И не жалейте бить стаканы,
 В которых выпито вино...

Мне жаль, что вымерли дуэли,
 Я ненавижу злую месть,
 Не запирать люблю я двери,
 Не зная брода, в воду лезть...

С разбегу бьюсь плечом о стену.
 А вдруг не выдержит стена?!
 Но, не смотря на перемены,
 Пока ещё стоит она.

А тот, кто выстроил теплицу
 И от воды, и от огня,
 Мне предложил остановиться...
 Понять не в силах он меня.

Но верю я, что меня встретит
 (Пусть год, пусть два, пусть три пройдёт)
 Тот человек - один на свете -
 Что до конца меня поймёт.

Что примет всей своей душою
 Таким, как есть я, без прикрас.
 И сразу вырастет большое,
 Живое счастье возле нас

И станет в ветре меньше дыма,
 И станет радовать гроза...
Но только б не проехать мимо,
 Ведь неисправны тормоза...

title: Celebrating 1,000 Episodes of Let's Have This Conversation
description:
Milestones of great significance deserve acknowledgment and celebration, and today marks a joyful success in this regard. Over five years ago, I embarked on a journey to share knowledge and information through a podcast that I initiated during the COVID-19 pandemic. This endeavor allowed me to express my journalistic talents and my desire to find common ground and build bridges of unity. Now, five years later, I am proud to announce that we have reached over 1,000 episodes of the "Let's Have This Conversation" podcast.

 

Through this podcast, I hope to have provided meaningful and thought-provoking conversations that encourage listeners to consider how they can contribute to the ongoing societal discourse on progress. I have been fortunate to interview and engage with a diverse array of individuals from various professions and backgrounds. I am incredibly grateful for the wisdom, information, and personal stories of triumph that many have shared with me over the years.

 

Together, we have worked to create an inclusive and accepting path forward, for which I am forever thankful. It is my hope that I have contributed to a legacy of inclusivity through these diverse conversations. A group of industry professionals whom I have had the privilege of interviewing over the past five years has compiled messages of encouragement and congratulations for this tremendous achievement of reaching 1,000 episodes, which I am excited to share with all of you.

transcript: ก็ สวัสดีค่ะรู้หรือยังคะตอนนี้โฮมเมดมี เครื่องสำอาหารรุ่นใหม่ค่ะกับง่ายด้วยมือ เดียวไม่ว่าจะเป็นเนื้อหมูกระเทียมหอม ส่วนต่างๆหรือกุ้งแห้งจะทำมันบดก็ยังได้ ค่ะ ไม่เลอะเทอะไม่เสียเวลาสะดวกรวดเร็ว เครื่องเดียวครบจบทุกทางสับหรือมีกับ เขียนวิทยมเดิมไม่ได้เลยค่ะเหมาะกับชีวิต ยุคเร่งรีบสุดๆเลย [เพลง] เครื่องขับรุ่นนี้ 2 ใบมีดสแตนเลสเร็ว กว่าละเอียดกว่า หลายคนเข้าใจว่า 4 ใบนี่เนี่ยจะต้องดี กว่า 2 ใบนี้ใช่ไหมคะเดี๋ยวเรามาพิสูจน์ กันเขามันจริงหรือเปล่าก็ได้มาในหัวที่ ใช้ 300 กรัมเท่ากันกำลังไฟ 320 บาทเท่า กับปั่น 10 วินาทีเริ่มค่ะอ่ะ [เพลง] เนื้อเพลงไหมคะว่าสองใบมีด Tour มีความ เนียนละเอียดมากกว่า 4 ใบมีเที่ยงมีความ เป็นเม็ดอยู่เลยค่ะ เครื่องจับอาหารโฮมเมดรุ่นนี้โทรแก้วนะทน ทานตอนจุ 1.2 ลิตรหัวมอเตอร์เป็นสแตนเลส อย่างดีหรือปรับได้ถึง 2 ระดับ สนใจทักแชทมาคุยกันหรือเข้ามาพิสูจน์ได้ ด้วยตัวเองที่มีละสุขสาขาใกล้บ้านท่านเลย ค่ะอ่ะ [เพลง]

Trong một lần bất ngờ, Thẩm Niệm Từ - ảnh hậu lừng lẫy một thời, và con gái Sở Khinh Nhuyễn xuyên không vào thế giới của một cuốn tiểu thuyết ngược văn đầy drama. Tại đây, họ trở thành mẹ chồng và nàng dâu trong một gia đình hào môn đầy mưu mô và bất công. Thẩm Niệm Từ, vốn là nữ chính bị chồng lạnh nhạt Châu Thiệu Lễ, quyết tâm làm lại cuộc đời, lấy lại ánh hào quang. Sở Khinh Nhuyễn, nàng dâu bị chồng - tổng tài bóp cổ Châu Yến Thanh - và gia đình chồng khinh miệt, dùng tài năng công nghệ và sự thông minh để phản công, vạch trần tội ác của kẻ thù.

Đối mặt với nữ phụ trà xanh Sở Thiến Thiến, mẹ chồng độc ác Từ Phượng Quyên, và những âm mưu đen tối từ nhà họ Thẩm, hai mẹ con đồng lòng phá vỡ số phận nghiệt ngã. Với sự đoàn kết và bản lĩnh, họ không chỉ trả thù những kẻ hãm hại mà còn xây dựng lại cuộc sống rực rỡ, khiến tra nam và kẻ thù phải trả giá. Liệu Thẩm Niệm Từ và Sở Khinh Nhuyễn có thể viết lại cái kết hạnh phúc cho chính mình trong thế giới ngược văn này?

description:
Balloon Rocket Science Fun learning  with children - Add some string in straw - enough to tie a line. You can tieto door handles or chairs. Blow  up balloon, tape balloon 🎈 to straw, (do not tie inflated balloon). You will want to see how balloon flies on the line once the air is released from balloon. 
Once you let go of the balloon the air / gas that is released  from balloon causes it to thrust from one end to the other end. 

Children love this activity🚀

title: GM 8L90 Transmission Horror Stories: Why They Fail So Fast!
description: #Shorts
transcript: As someone who has dedicated decades to the transmission industry, I've seen my fair share of poorly designed and manufactured units, but none quite as problematic as the General Motors 6L80, 8L90, and 10L80 transmissions. The 8L90, in particular, is infamous among professionals for its shocking lack of quality control. Hundreds of units torn down in my shop have revealed everything from misaligned clutches to inconsistent machining tolerances and subpar internal components that simply aren't built to last. It's no exaggeration to say that every time I open up one of these transmissions, I find a new reason to question how such a product ever made it past GM's quality assurance. The problems don't end at the assembly line. On the road, these transmissions are prone to the dreaded shutter, harsh shifting, delayed engagement, and erratic behavior. All symptoms of deeper design and manufacturing flaws. Owners are left frustrated as their vehicles become almost undrivable, with many reporting issues within just a few years or even months of light use. The 8L90s torque converter clutch is especially notorious for failing prematurely, often leading to catastrophic transmission damage that requires complete rebuilds or replacements. To make matters worse, GM's official response to these complaints has been woefully inadequate. The recommended double flush procedure, changing the transmission fluid twice in hopes of curing the shutter, is nothing but a band-aid solution. And in my experience, it rarely if ever solves the underlying problems. In fact, I believe this strategy is just a way for GM to buy time, avoid negative online press, and ultimately push frustrated customers into purchasing new vehicles instead of addressing the real issues with these transmissions. Amidst all this, class action lawsuits have piled up against General Motors with thousands of owners seeking justice for their unreliable transmissions. Yet, there is hope for those plagued by the 8L90s notorious flaws. Transmax transmissions in Okala, Florida, currently offers the only known effective fix. Their proprietary solutions address the root causes of failure, providing lasting reliability that simply isn't available from the manufacturer. For anyone suffering from GM transmission wos, Transmax is the trusted name that can finally deliver peace of mind.

transcript: Livro Apocalipse, capítulo 7. Os israelitas fiéis são salvos de perigos iminentes. Versículo 1. E depois destas coisas, vi quatro anjos que estavam sobre os quatro cantos da terra, retendo os quatro ventos da terra, para que nenhum vento soprasse sobre a terra, nem sobre o mar, nem contra árvore alguma. E vi outro anjo subindo da banda do sol nascente e que tinha o selo do Deus vivo. E clamou com grande voz aos quatro anjos, a quem fora dado o poder de danificar a terra e o mar, dizendo: "Não danifiqueis a terra, nem o mar, nem as árvores, até que hajamos assinalado na testa os servos do nosso Deus." E ouvi o número dos assinalados, e eram 144.000 assinalados de todas as tribos dos filhos de Israel. Da tribo de Judá havia 12.000 assinalados. Da tribo de Rubém 12.000. Da tribo de Gad 12.000. Da tribo de Assé 12.000. Da tribo de Naftali 12.000 da tribo de Manassés 12.000 da tribo de Simeão. 12.000 da tribo de Levi. 12.000 da tribo de Isacá. 12.000 da tribo de Zebulon, 12.000 da tribo de José, 12.000 da tribo de Benjamim, 12.000 Depois destas coisas, olhei e eis que aqui uma multidão a qual ninguém podia contar, de todas as nações e tribos e povos e línguas que estavam diante do trono e perante o cordeiro, trajando vestes brancas e com palmas nas suas mãos, e clamavam com grande voz, dizendo: "Salvação ao nosso Deus, que está sentado no trono e ao cordeiro." E todos os anjos estavam ao redor do trono e dos anciãos e dos quatro animais. E prostraram-se diante do trono sobre o seu rosto e adoraram a Deus, dizendo: Amém. Louvor e glória, e sabedoria e ações de graças e honra e poder e força ao nosso Deus para todo sempre. Amém. E um dos anciãos me falou, dizendo: Estes que estão vestidos de vestes brancas, quem são e de onde vieram? E eu disse-lhe: "Senhor, tu sabes?" E ele disse-me: "Estes são os que vieram de grande tribulação, lavaram as suas vestes e as branquearam no sangue do cordeiro. Por isso, estão diante do trono de Deus e o servem de dia e de noite no seu templo. E aquele que está sentado sobre o trono os cobrirá com a sua sombra. Nunca mais terão fome, nunca mais terão sede, nem sol, nem calma alguma cairá sobre ele. Porque o cordeiro que está no meio do trono os apacentará e lhes servirá de guia para as fontes das águas da vida. E Deus limpará de seus olhos toda a lágrima. M.

description:
#Nainital, the charming #Himalayan lake town, is a picture-postcard perfect #hill-station and one of the most popular in Northern India. Commonly known as the #‘Lake District’, Nainital is nestled high up in the Kumaon Himalayas at an altitude of around 2,000 m above sea level. This beautiful town in surrounded by seven hills, popularly known as ‘Sapta-Shring’ – Ayarpata, Deopata, Handi-Bandi, Naina, Alma, Lariya-Kanta and Sher-Ka-Danda. The majestic mountains and the sparkling waters of the lake add an immense lot to the beauty of the town.  The town is centred around the emerald mountain lake #Naini, which on most days is dotted with colourful sailboats

We will also highlight the importance of administering the vaccine at a young age, as this timing can significantly enhance its effectiveness.

title: Waltz from Fla Hallingdal
description: Waltz from Fla, Hallingdal, played by Willmare area fiddler Dempsey Schroeder (right) and Maggie Harp (Brooten) with student from his workshop (l to ri) Carla Manning, LaJean Ernst, Walter Sigtermans, Mary Pat Kleven, Don Schuck at the Willmar Community Center.   This is one of the heirloom fiddle tunes from West Central Minnesota, collected by Elmo Wick, that were played by the region's best fiddlers in the early 1900's. This project is headed by Mary Pat Kleven and sponsored by the Minnesota State Fiddlers Association. For more information on the Elmo Wick Project and the Elmo Wick Tune Book go to http://www.fiddlemn.com. This activity is made possible by the voters of Minnesota through a grant from the Minnesota State Arts Board, thanks to a legislative appropriation from the arts and culture heritage fund.

title: Occidente de El Salvador registró baja afluencia de pasajeros en vacaciones agostinas
description: Motoristas confirman que los buses circularon sin retrasos, pero con menos usuarios que en temporadas anteriores.
transcript: Continuamos con más información. Durante vacaciones agostinas se reportó menor afluencia de pasajeros en rutas hacia el occidente del país. Durante las festividades agostinas, la cantidad de usuarios en las rutas de autobuses que se dirigen al occidente del país disminuyó considerablemente. Según indicaron motoristas de algunas unidades del transporte colectivo. El servicio eh de transporte pues es normal, ¿verdad? La afluencia de personas, por lo menos de sonates a San Salvador, está bastante calmado, no hay mucha persona andamos prestando el servicio, ¿verdad? Y pues las personas se puedan mover hacia sus destinos y pues así cada quien a sus hogares. Pese a la baja demanda, los pasajeros destacaron que el servicio se mantuvo con regularidad, respetando los horarios habituales y con tiempos de espera mínimos, lo que permitió a quienes se movilizaron durante la semana hacerlo sin mayores contratiempos. Igual veo que ahí está la ruta puesta. Creo que creo que ha sido normal el transporte. Sí, porque lo veo con mucha frecuencia. Lo único que por la distancia para llegar hasta allá es un poco complicado. Ajá. Bueno, los buses van despacio esperando gente, ¿verdad? Por la vacación es que es que la gente casi no sale a trabajar, que es normal. En el último día de Asueto, algunos salvadoreños optaron por realizar paseos cortos o visitar a sus familias. Venimos desde Sonzonate a visitar a mi suegra acá. Sí, último día de vacación. Pues con mis dos hijos y mi nuera y mi sobrino y el papá de mis hijos. Este jueves 7 de agosto, el sector privado reanuda sus actividades laborales con normalidad. Los estudiantes y empleados del sector público retomarán sus jornadas el próximo lunes 11. Con imágenes de Ricardo Tobar, este es un informe de Kelly Abrego.

title: Çështja “McGonigal”, Elja Zotka: Dorian Duçkën e kam parë në aeroportin e Rinasit kur erdhën afganët
description:
Dorian Duçka, njëri nga dy shqiptarët që del në akt-akuzën e drejtësisë amerikane për ish-zyrtarin e lartë të FBI-së, McGonigal, ka qenë në Tiranë në muajin Gusht 2021, kur në Shqipëri mbërritën afganët.

Kështu thotë gazetarja e Tv Klan Elja Zotka në një lidhje për emisionin Opinion në Tv Klan, e cila deklaroi se z.Duçka e ka parë pikërisht në atë periudhë në aeroportin e Rinasit së bashku me Kryeministrin Edi Rama dhe ambasadoren amerikane.

Gazetarja Elja Zotka: Rama pranon që ka takuar në Tiranë por dhe në Nju Jork ish-shefin e zyrës së Nju Jorkut të FBI, po ashtu pranon që ka takuar edhe shqiptaro-amerikanin të clin e ka takuar pikërisht prej zyrtarit të FBI-së. Dhe takimet që ka pasur me të i ka pasur vetëm kur kanë qenë së bashku të tre. Po ashtu pranon dhe dihet në fakt botërisht që Dorian Duçka ka qenë këshilltar i Kryeministrit. Në fakt ai më parë ka qenë në zyrën e ish-ministrit të Jashtëm të asaj kohe në koalicionin PD-LSI, Ilir Metës, kur ishte ministër i Jashtëm. Më pas kaloi zv/ministër dhe kohët e fundit ishte këshilltar i Jashtëm i Kryeministrit. Unë në fakt për herë të fundit z.Duçka e kam parë kur në aeroportin e Rinasit mbërritën afganët. Ai ishte së bashku me z.Rama dhe me ambasadoren amerikane.

Blendi Fevziu: Ka qenë po ai që e ka shoqëruar Ramën në udhëtimin në Kiev dhe në takimin me Zelenskyn?

Gazetarja Elja Zotka: Në pamje nuk ka dalë, në pamjet që na janë shpërndarë ne, z.Duçka nuk shfaqet. Por për herë të fundit unë në pamjet televizive e kam parë z.Duçka kur erdhën në muajin Gusht 2021 afganët në Tiranë. Ndërkohë që mësohet që ai ka qenë këshilltar i jashtëm i Kryeministrit. Vetë Kryeministri e pohoi këtë dhe tha ka qenë këshilltar i jashtëm pa pagesë i imi, por të paktën 6 muajt e fundit ai nuk e ka ushtruar këtë funksion. Po ashtu z.Rama pranon që i ka takuar por sipas tij ka zero lidhje. Të gjitha ato çka akuzohet në Tiranë, sepse sipas tij po i bëhet një lexim i gabuar dhe i qëllimshëm në Tiranë gjithë këtij hetimi që po i bëhet zyrtarit të FBI. Dhe sipas tij është pikërisht z.Berisha që po e bën këtë lexim të gabuar me synimin siç thotë Rama për të fashitur të gjitha akuzat që atij i janë bërë aktualisht për 21 Janarin dhe implikimin që PS pretendon se ka pasur z.Berisha, ish-ministri i atëhershëm i Brendshëm Lulzim Basha dhe kreu i Gardës në vrasjen e 4 protestuesve të 21 Janarit 2011.

title: Bowser's Going to Kill Boo (Super Mario Party Jamboree-Part 8)
description:
Today on Super Mario Party Jamboree, we finish our game on Mega Wiggler's Tree Party, where I get Boo to steal coins from Bowser Jr. However, Bowser is Boo's boss, so this might not end well.
It's Mario's biggest party ever, Mario Party Jamboree, chock full of new modes and new minigames, some of which are locked behind motion controls. I'm going to play as much of this game as I possibly can, from the classic boards (both with CPUs and online randos), the Koopathlon, story mode, and much more. It will be fun, and it will be full of rage. Episodes will be uploaded on Sundays.

God of War es un videojuego de acción-aventura desarrollado por SCE Santa Monica Studio y publicado por Sony Interactive Entertainment. Su lanzamiento se produjo el 20 de abril de 2018 como un título exclusivo para la consola PlayStation 4.[1]​ Posteriormente, fue lanzado en Microsoft Windows el 14 de enero de 2022.[2]​ Se trata de la octava entrega de la serie de God of War, cronológicamente, y la secuela de God of War III. La historia se centra en la mitología nórdica y Kratos regresa como el protagonista principal.
Han pasado años desde que Kratos tomó su venganza contra los Dioses Olímpicos. Habiendo sobrevivido la pelea final contra su padre Zeus, Kratos vive ahora con su joven hijo Atreus en el mundo de los Dioses Nórdicos, una tierra hostil habitada por feroces monstruos y guerreros. Kratos deberá actuar como mentor y protector de su hijo, y tendrá que dominar la ira y enojo que tuvo durante muchos años y atar cabos sueltos

title: Read & Cook - I Love Cake
description:
Are you reading to be inspired to cook a new dish? Join Miss Janet as she reads "I Love Cake" by Tammi Sauer, Illustrated by Angie Rozelaar and published by Harper Collins. 

Love Cake? Try making Oatmeal Cake at home with these instructions!

Oatmeal Cake
 
1 cup quick cooking rolled oats
Pour 1 1/3 cups boiling water over the oats; stir well; set aside until cool.
Cream ½ cup margarine, 1 cup white sugar, 1 cup brown sugar. Add  eggs and beat. Sift together 1 1/3 cups all purpose flour, 1 teaspoon soda, 1 teaspoon cinnamon
½ teaspoon salt. Add sifted flour alternately with rolled oats.
Bake in a 9 x 11 inch pan at 350 F for 40 minutes.
 
Topping: 6 tablespoons melted butter
                 ½ cup brown sugar
                 1 cup sweetened coconut
                 ½ cup nuts, cut coarsely
                ¼ to 1/3 cups cream
               ½ teaspoon vanilla
 
Spread on hot cake and brown under broiler until brown and bubbly.
 
Enjoy!

title: Winter Transportation Help for Seniors  |  How Senior Home Care Keeps Older Adults Safe
description:
Winter weather presents significant mobility challenges for aging adults. Our latest video, "Winter Transportation Help for Seniors," explores how professional senior home care ensures safety during the coldest months. From navigating icy walkways to providing reliable escorted transportation for medical appointments and grocery trips, we cover essential strategies to prevent falls and isolation.

Learn how dedicated caregivers assist with vehicle snow removal and offer door-to-door support, keeping seniors active and connected when driving is no longer safe. Discover peace of mind with winter-ready care solutions.

Hi, I'm Joel Denney with CareBuilders at Home 
and today we're going to talk about winter   transportation help for seniors. How senior home 
care keeps older adults safe and on the move. Do   you care for an elderly loved one who lives in 
another part of the state or maybe in a different   state completely? Many families are doing their 
best from a distance. You want your senior to stay   independent, keep appointments, and enjoy life, 
but winter can make that feel stressful fast.   Roads get slick, daylight disappears early, 
and even simple errands become risky. The good   news is that seniors don't have to choose between 
staying home and driving in dangerous conditions.   Senior Home Care can provide dependable winter 
transportation and practical support that reduces   driving risks altogether. When you can't be there, 
a caregiver can help your loved one get where   they need to go safely and help them avoid the 
winter driving hazards that worry families most.   four non-weather obstacles that can make 
winter driving harder for seniors. Most   people know they shouldn't drive in a blizzard or 
ice storm. But even when the weather looks fine,   older drivers can face challenges that make winter 
travel unsafe. The key thing to remember, senior   home care can help with every one of these issues. 
Either by preparing your loved one for safer   travel or by providing transportation so they 
don't have to drive at all. Their car may not be   prepared for winter. Vehicles need steady upkeep 
and winter demands even more. A car that doesn't   have proper tires, reliable windshield wipers, 
working heat, or good defrosting can become   dangerous when temperatures drop and roads freeze. 
Some older adults don't realize how quickly   conditions change or may put off maintenance 
because it feels overwhelming. A caregiver can   remind your loved one about seasonal maintenance, 
help schedule service, and even accompany them to   appointments. More importantly, when roads are 
icy or the car isn't winter ready, senior home   care can provide transportation so your loved 
one doesn't have to drive a vehicle that isn't   safe. If your senior doesn't drive confidently at 
night, winter creates a tricky situation. The sun   can set before 5:00 p.m. and errands that used to 
happen in daylight may now stretch into the dark.   Some seniors may underestimate how long an 
appointment or stop will take and end up driving   after nightfall without intending to. Caregivers 
can help plan errands earlier in the day and track   schedules so your loved one isn't rushing home 
after dark. And when timing is tight, a caregiver   can drive them instead, keeping them off the road 
at night entirely. In winter, it's safest to dress   as if the car might stop in the middle of nowhere. 
That means warm layers, gloves, and proper shoes.   But seniors who park indoors or make quick trips 
sometimes forget how cold it truly is outside.   If something goes wrong, they may be underdressed 
for a long wait or walk. Caregivers can help your   loved one prepare appropriately before leaving 
the house, ensuring they're bundled up for   unexpected delays. If a caregiver is providing 
transportation, they can also help your senior   in and out of the vehicle safely and quickly, 
minimizing exposure to cold and icy surfaces.   Winter changes familiar roads. Snow and ice can 
cover signs, make lane markings hard to see,   and hide important turn indicators like arrows 
for left turn lanes. Even routine drives can   become confusing, especially for older adults 
with memory changes or slower reaction time. A   caregiver can ride along, help with navigation, or 
handle driving entirely when visibility is poor.   That support reduces stress and lowers the chance 
of missed turns or unsafe last second decisions.   Here's something families often overlook. 
Getting out of the house in winter isn't   just a convenience. It's tied to health and 
quality of life. Seniors still need to get to   medical appointments and therapy sessions, pick up 
prescriptions, shop for groceries and essentials,   attend faith services or community events, see 
friends and family. When winter transportation   becomes unreliable, seniors may skip important 
care or become isolated. Senior home care helps   prevent that by providing steady, safe access to 
the world outside the home. Sometimes your loved   one will still want or need to drive. Senior 
home care can support safer driving habits by   helping with these practical strategies. Winter 
driving depends on vision, hearing, flexibility,   and alertness. Eyeglass prescriptions need to 
be current. Hearing aid should work properly,   and regular stretching helps with turning 
the head or reacting quickly. A senior home   care provider can help your loved ones stay 
consistent with health routines and attend   vision or hearing appointments, both of which 
make driving safer. And if health is slipping,   caregivers can step in with transportation before 
driving becomes risky. A winter ready car should   always have at least a half tank of gas, tire 
pressure checked, clean fluids, and dependable   brakes. Many seniors forget these details or 
find upkeep tiring. Senior home care can help   by reminding your loved one of maintenance 
needs, helping them schedule their service,   and driving them to or from the mechanic. If 
the car isn't ready, caregivers can provide   transportation so your senior doesn't drive under 
unsafe conditions. Every winter vehicle should   include basic emergency supplies in case someone 
gets stuck. Seniors may not think to pack one or   may not be able to gather everything themselves. A 
caregiver can help your loved one build and store   an emergency kit. Check it seasonally and make 
sure supplies are easy to access. And again,   with caregiver transportation available, the 
odds of your senior being stranded on winter   roads drop dramatically. Warm, practical clothing 
matters for any winter outing. Senior home care   can help your loved one choose winter appropriate 
layers and footwear before they leave. Caregivers   can also help prevent slips by offering steady 
support on icy sidewalks, steps, and parking lots.   One of the biggest winter dangers for seniors. 
The most important winter reminder. It's okay   to ask for help. Many seniors are reluctant to 
stop driving, even temporarily. They may worry   about losing independence or being a burden. 
But accepting transportation help in winter,   isn't giving something up. It's protecting safety 
and preserving freedom. Senior homeare offers a   respectful middle ground. Your loved one can still 
go where they want and maintain their routine   without the stress and danger of winter driving. 
Caregivers can drive them to appointments,   errands, and social outings, and they can help 
prepare your senior for safe travel when driving   is necessary. When you can't be there to help, 
senior care can. It keeps winter from shrinking   your loved ones world and helps you feel confident 
they're getting where they need to go safely,   even in the toughest season of the year. If you 
are considering home care in the Twin Cities   metro area, please contact our friendly staff here 
at CareBuilders at Home Minnesota. You can reach   us at 612-260-2273 and we would be honored 
to help with care for you or your loved one.

A week earlier,  she received her first chiropractic adjustment.  She had 3 spots that got red light therapy and adjustments, which were left shoulder,  center top line, and right hip.   

When I brought her home at 7 months, she had a small injury on her left shoulder that looked like it could have been a pasture incident while just being a baby running around.   I noticed over the next few weeks as we were getting to know each other that her right hind was short moving both forward and backward. I spent some much needed time working her muscles and saw improvement, but I knew there was more that needed work.   So I found a mobile equine chiropractor.   

This was her first ever PEMF session, and you can see that she was incredibly receptive.   This clip is in the first 2-3 minutes. She then relaxed,  nodded off for a bit, and then went to munching on hay.

title: Những mẫu chuyện bên Thầy  -110
description: nam mô a di đà Phật
transcript: Tôi có hai người bạn thân là Lê Văn Lợi và Lê Văn Xô ở ấp Long Thạnh, làng Long Kiến, quận Chợ Mới. Chúng tôi rủ nhau cùng đi lên Hòa Hảo nghe Đức Thầy thuyết pháp rồi quy y vào đạo. Anh Lợi về một cái áo già mặc đi lên tổ đình làm công quả trước sân. Đức thầy sau khi xong việc độ bệnh và thuyết giáo, ngài đi đến chỗ bạn tôi đang làm công quả. Ngài nói như trầm rồ, "Chà, mặc áo già hả?" Bạn tôi còn chưa hiểu ra sao thì Đức Thầy nói thêm, "Mặc áo già là phải tu cho già nghe không?" Từ đấy bạn ấy tự hiểu mình tu hành còn đớt thì không nên mặc đồ già. Theo lời ông Nguyễn Quý Nhân Mỹ chợ mới, sau ngày Đức Thầy khai đạo khoảng 4 tháng tại tổ đình có các ông chủ cưu năm chơn tiếp tay với Đức Thầy lo việc độ bệnh cho bá tánh. Một hôm, Đức Thầy nói cùng mấy ông ấy, "Hôm nay hai ông cùng tôi đi đám dỗ gần đây." Ông Năm Chơn liền nói, "Dạ khoan, thầy chờ tôi một chút." Nói xong ông Năm đi riết về nhà ở phía dưới tổ đình, mặc bộ đồ màu già mới mai rồi trở lại đặng cùng đi với Đức Thầy. Đức thầy thấy ông thay đồ già, Đức Thầy liền khuyên: "Ông nên mặc đồ bà ba bình thường như tôi là được rồi. Ông nên biết mặc bộ đồ già là phải xét mình có được cái hạnh đức trang nghiêm hay chăng. Có người hỏi đạo lý ông có giảng giải thông suốt như thầy hay không? Nếu được á thì nên mặt. Ông Năm Chơn nghe Đức Thầy nói mau mau trở về thay bộ đồ khác rồi mới trở lại đi đám dỗ cùng Đức Thầy và mấy người kia. Thuật theo lời ông giáo nhượng. Phần luận giải giảng đức thầy có câu: "Dọn bề trong mới gọi đẹp xinh, chớ mang lốt bề ngoài chẳng tốt." Thời gian Đức Thầy mới mở đạo, Ngài để tóc dài ván lên mép tai và phủ đến sau gái. Những ảnh chụp của ngài lúc ấy thấy nét nghiêm nghị hơi khắc khổ. Do lúc trước đó ngài bị bệnh liên miên. Những tín đồ quy y với ngài thần tượng hình ảnh ấy mà làm theo cho giống cho ra vẻ người đạo mạo. Trong đó có học theo hạnh mặc đồ già dạt mẻ. Nhưng đạo phục ấy thường dành cho hàng xuất gia đầu tròn áo vuông có phẩm vị trong giới tăng ni Phật. Chuyện trên là do sự thuật lại về lời dạy của Đức Thầy mà không thấy có nêu lên ở giáo phần nào trong kinh giảng. Biết như vậy để chúng ta tự xem xét về đạo phục và phẩm hạnh của mình. Phẩm hạnh mà không tương xứng với đạo phục thì dễ gây phản cảm sao. Phản cảm là sự dè biểu chê trách, làm tổn đức bình sinh của mình và của người. Việc mặt cũng cần khiêm tốn và tế nhị đúng cách như việc ăn và việc ở. Vậy chuyện thứ 34 gian thuở Đức Thầy mở đạo. Lúc ấy Đức Ông thân sinh của Đức Thầy vẫn chưa thật sự tin tưởng và nể phục vẫn nghĩ mình là người lớn chủ gia đình như từ trước tới giờ. Nên một hôm thấy Đức Bà cúng lại, Đức Ông nói có ý bông đùa. Khi nào bà về Tây Phương á cho tôi hóa gian với nghe. Đức thầy đang nằm dùng ngồi dậy rồi nói, "Nếu ông đi trước bà thì ông quá gian ai? Ông nên biết ông tu á ông đắc, bà tu bà đắc." Về sau Đức Ông quá giảng trước Đức Bà. Phần luận giải: Sự tu hành chủ yếu nơi tự lực nhưng người ăn tự no, người tự đi mới tới nơi. Đấy là đạo lý đương nhiên mà ai cũng biết. Người đời có khi nói tếu rằng nữa ông bà có đi lên cho tôi điếu áo nghe. Đấy có khi là điều khen tặng có vẻ thân bật về công hạnh người đó thường làm. Nhưng trong trường hợp này, Đức Ông chưa thật sự đồng tình với việc lo tu của Đức Bà, chỉ nói với ý trêu chọc và có phần mỉa mai. Vì vậy, Đức Thầy mới lẹ làng chỉnh lại ý nghĩ của Đức Ông là ai tu nấy đắc và chưa biết ai mất trước ai để mà ỷ lại nương nhờ sự cứu vớt. Đức thầy rõ hiểu tâm lý từng người, ở đây lại là người thân trong nhà nên ngài nhân cơ hội đó lại đưa ra cảnh báo có tính nghiêm túc để giác tịnh Đức Ông. Và người trong đạo còn tín phục hơn khi cảnh báo của Ngài có tính tiên tri và chính xác là sau đó Đức Ông mất trước Đức Bà. Bài học từ câu chuyện này là sự tự lực, không nên nương kệ vào điều chưa chắc chắn ở ngoại mình. Câu chuyện thứ 35. Theo dấu chân thầy. Khoảng tháng giê năm Canh Thình năm 1940, Đức Thầy dẫn ông Ngô Thành Bá tức Biện Đài là một tín đồ ở cùng làng với ngài đi viếng núi Tà Lân. Khởi hành ngày mùng s qua đến ngày 11 tháng Giêng, Đức Thầy và ông Biện Đài cùng lên đến ngọn núi cao chót vót, ít có cây mọc, đường xá hiểm trợ khó đi, lúc phải bò lên, lúc phải tuột xuống. Qua đoạn ấy, ông đài bị ngất xỉu, tối tâm mài mặt. Đức thầy phải cho ông nhai nấm lá cây có chất ngộ. Lát sau ông khỏe lại rồi thầy trò mới tiếp tục đi. Trên núi có suối chải, nước trong như mắt mèo. Có lúc Đức Thầy phải lội qua con suối. Nhưng ngài nhìn lại sau thấy ông Biện Đài vừa vịn vừa bò trên một thân cây ngã ngang qua suối. Đức thầy rầy ông sao ông không lỗi dưới suối vậy? Ông đài đáp: "Lỗi chi cho ước mình." Đức thầy nghiêm vọng bảo, thầy đi đằng nào trò phải đi đằng nấy chứ. Từ đây cắm ông không đi như vậy nữa nhé. Phần luận giải. Mẫu chuyện trên cũng là dạng lấy việc nhỏ để minh thị cho bài học lớn. Đức thầy lấy một mãng hội thoại ngắn trong lúc đi non với ông Biện Đài để dạy dỗ trong hàng tín đồ việc tuân thủ các quy cũ của ngài đã vạch ra và phòng tránh những trường hợp xé rào cải biên. Trong bệch mù hoang dả của đêm tối vô minh, Đức Thầy đã dạy công khai hóa. Đạo là vốn thiệt cái đàn. Ta ra sức dộ cho toàn chúng sanh. Gần như bắt buộc người đệ tử theo thầy phải đi chính chắng trên con đường ấy, đi chệt ra tức là sẽ gặp gai chong hầm hố, nguy hiểm muôn phần cho huệ mạng. Dấu chân đi trước của Đức Phật Tổ đã ghi rõ lắm. Chân chúng sanh chỉ cần bấm đi theo. Sin embargo esto no tiene ningún tipo de sanción debido a que él no fue a jugar sino que pasó un rato a visitar a los chicos y a dejarle una valija que tiene según Alfa una "sorpresa".Esto no fue todo y Camila Lattanzio protagonizó en el patio un momento con respecto a Romina, que se viralizó rápidamente.

Приветствую вас
Этим года мы будем проверять
Является ли один объект родителям для другого
Для наглядности мы будем менять цвета у родителя
Создаем переменную
Присваиваем этой переменный материал из объекта
И если происходит соприкосновения, то мы проверяем
Если этот объект является ребенком текущего объекта, то мы красим в синий цвет, иначе в красный
Я сделать такую сцену
Получается синий является ребенком, а красный нет
И при перемещении синего внутрь
То родитель красится в синий
Если красный куб движется, то родитель видишь что это не его ребенок и перекрашивается в красный
Если мы закинем красного под сферу, то при прикосновении он покраситься в синий
Если мы обратным выкинем то снова красный
На это все. Спасибо за внимание. До свидания

🖊️ Explained by Shaykh Abu Muhammad al-Maghribee (ḥafiẓahullāh)

In this enlightening series, Shaykh Abu Muhammad al-Maghribee explains the meanings and implications of Allah’s Beautiful Names (al-Asmāʾ al-Ḥusnā). With references from the Qur’ān, Sunnah, and the understanding of the Salaf, he shows how a Muslim’s belief and worship are strengthened through correct knowledge of Allah’s Names and Attributes.
📚 A vital study for every Muslim who desires to increase their love of Allah, improve their worship, and deepen their understanding of Tawḥīd.
📌 Subscribe, turn on notifications, and share this beneficial knowledge.
🤲 May Allah grant us correct understanding of His Names and Attributes, allow us to live by them, and reward you abundantly for seeking and spreading this knowledge. Jazakumullahu khayran.

The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Whoever calls to guidance will have a reward similar to those who follow him, without their reward being diminished in the least."
📚 Sahih Muslim (2674)

The Prophet ﷺ said:
"Indeed, Allah has ninety-nine Names. Whoever enumerates them will enter Paradise."
📚 Sahih al-Bukhari (2736), Sahih Muslim (2677)

transcript: 速報週刊身長街党に関しての記事を新たに 公開これ絶対でまだロの 声当日ホテル内で行為があったことは伊東 側もすでに認めているつまり代表戦が行わ れたその夜女性とホテルで行為に及んだか どうか自体は争っていない人気も実力も 抜群の伊東だけに無実を信じたいという声 は大きいその中には意図的にフェイク情報 を拡散しているものもいるようだ典型は 週刊身長は伊東には取材すらしていないと いうものだろう実際には伊藤本人 マネジメント担当者代理人弁護士への取材 を申し入れ事実確認や反論を求めたものの 回答を拒否してきたというのが事実で ある伊東側に電話を断られましたは取材と 言えるのか本人に取材もしてないのに ホテルでの行為は認めているって誰が認め てるの伊東側に回答拒否られてるのに行為 があったと伊東側が認めてるってほんまに どういうこと本入に取材してない時点で こいつらが勝手に言ってるだけに過ぎませ ん行為は本人も認めてるってデイリー身長 以外で報じてるメディアないけど伊東は いつどこで誰にその発言したん取材して ないのに認めてるわ草国賊は黙って配管 しろカスメディア片方の言分だけ聞いて 記事にしてる段階で記者として0点配管に なれ文章中で矛盾が発生するというとても 面白い記事でした回答を全拒否されたのに なぜ認めたとあるの か

title: WEBINAR: Learn How Healthcare Is Evolving with Intelligent Automation w/Blue Prism
description:
From back-office to front-office to pharmacy, intelligent automation is making radical changes to the healthcare industry. The door is now opening for automation to assist in everything from vaccination to billing to building out the nursing space. 

Kim Kass, Agilify Director of Business Development, and Anna Twomey, Blue Prism Senior Solutions Advisor, Americas Healthcare, discuss how intelligent automation has radically transformed the healthcare industry and what IA can do in the future to impact the patient experience positively. 

In this webinar, you will learn: 

- How IA is being used to relieve the administrative burden for healthcare workers
- Use cases around how IA has positively impacted healthcare
- What’s next for IA in healthcare
- How IA is evolving outside of the healthcare industry 
- What other industries can learn from healthcare

_________________________________

Agilify is North America’s leading intelligent automation practitioner. We provide robotic process automation (RPA) platforms, training, consultation and monitoring services that improve your business processes in finance, human resources, the supply chain and more.

Agilify’s digital workforce solutions include its Automation Academy, Automation Assurance, and Automation Delivery groups, each providing the knowledge and know-how to help customers embrace these new technologies.

Agilify is the guide that many of the world’s most respected companies have selected to lead them through this new era workforce transformation, one that seeks to fulfill the true potential of a combined human and digital workforce and help realize a return on your investment.

GET IT ALL DONE ON MY WEEKEND OFF AS A PREGNANT WORKING MOM WITH 2 KIDS PREGNANT MOM GET IT ALL DONE

Let's get some things done around the house! Easter is coming up in a week and I have to get the baskets together, dye some eggs and get my self prepared for making dinner all day! I also went grocery shopping at Aldi, put that away, and organized the house for the baby! I do have another organization video coming up in a week, so make sure you subscribe to my channel to stay up to date! What are you Easter traditions with your kiddos, or grand kiddos during this time of year?

Welcome! My name is Jessica Lauren! I’m a working mama of 2 kiddos and pregnant with my 3rd. I work full time as a clerk for the City of Philadelphia, and I create YouTube videos twice a week! My kids, Lillie (13) and Oliver (4), are my life. I basically do everything in my power to give them a beautiful life to grow and be loved. Have you noticed the age gap? I had Lillie at a very young age. I met Anthony, my fiancé, when Lillie was 5. And from there, we created an amazing foundation for a great future. I am all about blended families, because I am from one myself! We really value equality in our house, meaning everyone gets treated the same no matter if they are blood or not. We express how we deal with coparenting, being a step parent, how we raise the children, and how this life style effects the kids in my youtube videos! We are very open about being a blended family and welcome every single one of you to join us as we grow!

title: How to Transform Yourself (Hindi) #fitness gym #workout
description:
Transforming yourself involves making intentional changes in various aspects of your life—physically, mentally, emotionally, or spiritually. Here’s a general guide to help you begin your self-transformation journey:

1. Self-Awareness
Evaluate your current self: Identify areas of your life that need improvement (e.g., habits, mindset, relationships).
Set clear goals: Know what you want to achieve and why. Break your goals into specific, measurable steps.
2. Change Your Mindset
Adopt a growth mindset: Believe that you can improve and develop through effort and learning.
Practice gratitude and positive thinking: Reframe challenges as opportunities and focus on your strengths.
3. Develop Healthy Habits
Physical well-being: Regular exercise, proper sleep, and a balanced diet have a huge impact on mental and emotional health.
Mental health: Practice mindfulness, meditation, or journaling to manage stress and gain clarity.
4. Continuous Learning
Read, listen, and learn: Seek knowledge through books, courses, and mentors to expand your skill set and understanding.
Challenge yourself: Push beyond your comfort zone to develop resilience and new capabilities.
5. Surround Yourself with Support
Positive influences: Seek out people who inspire and motivate you. Distance yourself from negative influences.
Accountability partners: Share your goals with someone who can hold you accountable for your progress.
6. Take Action
Start small: Focus on making small, incremental changes that will accumulate over time.
Be consistent: Transformation takes time, so persistence and regular action are key.
Embrace failure: See setbacks as learning experiences, not reasons to give up.
7. Spiritual and Emotional Growth
Reflect and meditate: Develop practices that foster inner peace, whether through prayer, meditation, or connecting with nature.
Emotional intelligence: Learn to manage your emotions, empathize with others, and improve your interpersonal relationships.
8. Track and Celebrate Progress
Regularly assess your progress: Keep track of small wins and celebrate achievements along the way.
Adjust your approach: If something isn’t working, don’t be afraid to change strategies.
Transformation is a gradual process, and it requires commitment and patience. Start by identifying the areas you want to focus on, and build from there.

title: Buffalo Countertop Induction Hobs
description:
Reduce your energy consumption and costs with the Buffalo induction hob.
Using induction technology, the hob directs up to 90% more energy into the cooking vessel reducing energy waste and speeding up the cooking process.
And when a pan is removed, the hob will automatically shut off power to that heating zone so there’s even less wasted energy.  
Designed for practicality, the Buffalo hob combines its durable stainless steel construction with an easy-to-clean black ceramic glass top.
There are 3 versions of the 3kW hob available with a choice of controls. Choose from either touch screen, button controls or manual dial.
Looking for more power? A hardwired double-induction unit is also available. Ideal for multitasking, this powerhouse features two independently controlled cooking zones and an impressive 7-kilowatts of power.
Buffalo countertop induction hobs: where power meets precision.

title: 10,500 (Pen House 1) ISA Brown Layers EGG PRODUCTION RATE At Week 23 #eggs #isabrown
description:
Maximizing Egg Production in Poultry Farming: Our ISA Brown Layer Journey with Big Dutchman Equipment. Join us as we show you our journey with our ISA Brown layers in our battery cage system, equipped with Big Dutchman poultry equipment. We share our experience with transitioning from grower complete chicken feed to pre-layer chicken feed, achieving optimum weight uniformity, and changing to layer phase 1 complete feed. We also showcase our poultry-specific LEDs and our 16-hour light protocol. Don't miss our egg production rate and weight trajectory. Learn valuable tips and tricks for managing sexual maturity and ensuring maximum egg production in your poultry farming venture.

Our Poultry Farm Construction remains ongoing, we decided to proceed in stocking the first Pen House with 10,500 ISA Brown Chickens / Layers on July 15, 2022. We stocked at 14 weeks due to construction delays. Our flock are now 23 weeks of age. As you can see, this is a battery cage system. We are using big dutchman poultry equipment.

In this poultry farming video we showed: 
1. Our ISA BROWN Egg production rate
2. The Weight Trajectory 
3. Our Poultry Specific LEDs in use at night

To maximize commercial egg production in poultry farming, we transitioned from Grower complete chicken feed  to Prelayer Chicken feed when our average weight was 1.3kg; Uniformity of 80%; and Chickens were above 15 weeks of age. In our previous videos, we emphasized that when changing from one feed to another, it is important to do so gradually. When transitioning from one feed to another, begin with 80% of current ration and 20% of new ration. Gradually increase the amount of new ration vs the old each day until the old feed is totally replaced. This minimizes disruption as chickens feed based on sight. If you notice the flocks going off feed at any point in the transition process, take an extra day or two and slow the transition down. The transition can last from 7 to 10 days. 

When commercial layers are 12 weeks until commencement of egg production, change of poultry feed is based on body weight. This is because Pullet body weight at onset of laying is the main factor that influences egg weight and the best predictor of future laying performance. Given that we did not receive our ISA Brown Point of Layers or Point of Cages until 14 weeks, we prioritized achieving the optimum weight uniformity by 16 or 18 weeks of age. Usually, when flock uniformity is high at 16 weeks of age, egg production is higher, and mortality is lower after 55 – 60 weeks of age.

Once our egg production began, we continued Pre-layer complete feed until we achieved about 10% production, before switching to Layer Phase 1 complete feed.  Our current ISA BROWN EGG production rate as shown in the video is 33%

We also began increasing the light duration for Natural Day Light to a 16-hour light protocol. We are adding 1 hour per week until 16 hours total light is achieved. We are using Poultry Specific LEDs for our lightening.  We are currently at 14 hours of light.  

Our open house system is a difficult system for controlling sexual maturity. The natural day length at which the pullets will be exposed to at 19 weeks of age will guide he light. Per our protocol, we avoided any light increase before 19 weeks of age.

transcript: In this video, you are going to see how to insert our triangle with angles in Microsoft Word document. As you can see here, let's get started. To insert the triangle, go to insert, go to shape, pick this right triangle shape, and hold down the shift key and drag it over here like this. Go to shape fill. Make it no fill. Go to shape outline. Go to wide and increase the wide to three point. Again go to insert. Go to shape. Pick a rectangle shape and drag it like this. To make the angle, go to shape fill. Make it no fill. Go to shape outline. Go to wide and make it three points. To make these two angles, go to insert, go to shape, select this arc shape, hold down the shift key and drag it like this. Go to shape outline and go to wide and make it three points. And go to shape outline and select this color. Rotate it like this. Place it over here. And use this yellow point to adjust it. Press Ctrl D to duplicate. Rotate it and place it like this. And adjust it. Now I have to write the angle. To insert the degree symbol, go to insert. Go to shape picker text box. Drag it over here like this. Go to insert. Go to equation. Go to insert new equation. Go to script. Select super script. Select the first box right here 90. Select the second box and go to insert symbol and select the degree. Now select the text box. Go to shape format shape outline. Make it no outline. Go to shape fill. Make it no fill. Now let me reduce its size and place it like this. Press Ctrl D to duplicate. Place it over here. Press Ctrl D to duplicate and place it like this. Change the degree from here. And this is looking beautiful. So hope you found this video helpful. If you like this video, please share this video with your friends and family. And don't forget to subscribe. Thank you.

description:
#aqueteleoitinerante24 #aqimadrid #aqueteleo

Un espacio para conocer el poemario «Con don pesos ya no alcanza» de Ana Belén Jara (Argentina),  algunos poemas de No-Lugar de Natalí Aranda Andrades (Chile) y las cartas poema que Gian Pierre Codarlupo (Perú) recoge en su editorial Poema poema.

title: 【材料3つ】とろけるヨーグルトケーキ作り方〜混ぜて冷やすだけ〜
description:
◯とろけるヨーグルトケーキ◯


----------------材料-------------------
・粉ゼラチン5g
・水大さじ2
・オイコス170g
・砂糖25g


---------------作り方-----------------
①耐熱容器にゼラチン、水を入れてふやかしておく
②別のボウルにオイコス、砂糖を入れたら混ぜる
③①を電子レンジで加熱して取り出したら②のボウルに入れて混ぜる
④オイコスの洗った容器に全部流し込んで空気を抜いたら冷蔵庫で3時間以上冷やす
⑤冷え固まったらお皿にひっくり返して取り出し、完成
